name: Freaky Frida
bio: Smiles at everyone. Nobody has seen her blink.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model (Drive folder, 2026-11-01: "freaky frida lowpoly"). The download is textured but not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A wide-eyed girl in pigtails, a tactical vest and camouflage shorts. Landmarks: found on the mesh, then the shoulders moved out to the arms' roots (found at the base of the neck, 6% of her height from the middle: the upper arms ran through the chest and took the vest with them, which tore at the shoulder in the hold) and the elbows a little out; `armCloth` keeps the vest's armholes on the body. Intake 2026-11-05 step 2b: its re-rigged download was built and not used (grip audit 0 before, 3 after (no finger chains: re-fitted)); this build kept.
